{{- /* A guide page's `api_symbols` frontmatter ("@gooddata/sdk-ui-charts:Headline") resolved to their API reference pages, for the chip row above the title (api-reference-panel.html) and the "API reference:" line of the page's Markdown version (md/header.html). Symbols resolve through the page version's api_refs (api-data.html), so slug rules stay single-source with the generator. Every hit is re-checked with site.GetPage — a missing data file (clean clone, no SDK build), a known-miss symbol, or a stale entry all degrade to nothing. Expects: the page. Returns a slice of dicts: page (the reference page) and entry (its api_refs entry: title, kind, deprecated, stability). */ -}} {{- $links := slice -}} {{- with (partialCached "api-data.html" . .Section).refs -}} {{- $refs := . -}} {{- range $.Params.api_symbols -}} {{- $parts := split (strings.TrimPrefix "@gooddata/" .) ":" -}} {{- if eq (len $parts) 2 -}} {{- $slug := printf "%s.%s" (index $parts 0) (lower (index $parts 1)) -}} {{- with index $refs $slug -}} {{- $entry := . -}} {{- with site.GetPage .path -}} {{- $links = $links | append (dict "page" . "entry" $entry) -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $links -}}
